HOW TO APPLY Please reply with: The word YERBALIST at the top of your message, so we know you read this post The largest set of books you've personally maintained (monthly transaction volume and revenue size is enough — no client names), and how long you've used QuickBooks Online An answer, in your own words, to this: a client sends us $10,000. $8,000 of that is meant to be spent on advertising on their behalf, and $2,000 is our fee. How would you record that, and why does the distinction matter? A short description of how you'd set up a recurring monthly invoice in QuickBooks Online for a client who signed mid-month and owes a prorated amount first Your available hours in US Eastern Time Applications without the code word, or without answers to questions 3 and 4, will not be reviewed.

title: SEO & GEO Strategy Lead-AI Search & Technical SEO
job_title: SEO & GEO Strategy Lead-AI Search & Technical SEO
description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced SEO & GEO Strategy Lead to own and lead our organic search and AI-search strategy. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who understands both traditional SEO and the rapidly evolving world of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search, and answer-engine visibility. The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with strong content strategy, authority building, analytics, AI knowledge, leadership, and exceptional organizational skills. This person must be an extremely organized, proactive self-starter who can manage multiple SEO initiatives simultaneously, establish clear priorities, maintain detailed project tracking, lead a small team, and ensure projects move from strategy through execution and measurement. You will be responsible for developing and executing the overall SEO and GEO strategy, identifying opportunities before being asked, and continuously adapting our approach as Google, AI search, and the broader search landscape evolve. Key Responsibilities SEO & Organic Growth Strategy -Own the overall SEO and organic growth strategy -Develop short-, medium-, and long-term SEO roadmaps tied to traffic, visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue -Identify high-impact opportunities proactively rather than waiting for assignments -Monitor Google algorithm updates, AI-search developments, and changes in SEO best practices -Analyze competitors and identify keyword, content, backlink, technical, and authority gaps -Prioritize initiatives based on expected business impact rather than rankings alone -Create clear strategies and execution plans for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery -Work closely with marketing, content, development, merchandising, and e-commerce teams Technical SEO Own and continuously improve technical SEO across the website, including: -Site architecture and crawlability -Indexation -XML sitemaps -Robots.txt -Canonicalization -Redirects -Duplicate-content management -Internal linking architecture --Core Web Vitals -Page speed -Mobile SEO -JavaScript SEO -Structured data and ---------- markup -Product, category, article, FAQ, organization, breadcrumb, and other applicable schema -Faceted navigation and URL parameter management -Technical SEO audits and implementation roadmaps The candidate must be comfortable identifying technical issues, understanding their business impact, prioritizing fixes, and working directly with developers to ensure proper implementation. GEO & AI Search Strategy Develop and lead our Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search strategy. Responsibilities include: -Improve brand and content visibility within AI-powered search and answer engines -Understand how traditional SEO signals interact with AI-generated answers and recommendations -Structure content so it can be easily understood, referenced, and surfaced by search engines and AI systems -Develop strategies around entities, topical authority, structured data, citations, brand mentions, and authoritative sources -Evaluate how AI platforms are discovering, understanding, and referencing our brand and competitors -Identify opportunities to improve visibility across conversational and AI-powered search experiences -Monitor the evolution of GEO, answer-engine optimization, and AI search -Test emerging strategies and measure which tactics create meaningful business results -Separate meaningful developments from short-lived SEO or AI trends -The candidate should understand that GEO is an evolving discipline and be comfortable testing, measuring, learning, and adapting quickly as the ecosystem changes. AI & Automation We want someone who actively and intelligently uses AI as part of their daily SEO workflow. The candidate should understand how to use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of: Keyword and topic research Content briefs SERP analysis Competitor research Content-gap analysis Internal-linking analysis Schema development and validation SEO audits Content optimization Data analysis Reporting Research Workflow automation Process efficiency We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate articles. The successful candidate will understand how to use AI strategically while maintaining quality, originality, accuracy, search intent, brand authority, and editorial standards. On-Page SEO & Content Strategy -Develop keyword strategies based on search intent, competition, opportunity, and business value -Optimize product pages, category pages, landing pages, and informational content -Build scalable internal-linking strategies -Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, copy, URLs, images, and structured content -Conduct content-gap and competitor analyses -Develop topic clusters and topical-authority strategies -Create and manage an SEO-focused blog and content roadmap -Provide detailed SEO briefs to writers and content teams -Audit existing content and determine what should be improved, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or removed -Ensure content supports both traditional SEO and emerging GEO objectives Off-Page SEO & Authority Building -Develop and manage a sustainable authority-building strategy that includes: -Backlink acquisition -Digital PR -Guest posting -Relevant industry placements -Brand mentions -Partnerships -Link-gap analysis -Competitor backlink analysis -Outreach strategies -Identification of high-quality authoritative websites The candidate must understand the difference between high-quality authority building and low-quality or spam-based link building and protect the company from tactics that could create long-term SEO risk. Analytics & Performance Must have strong working knowledge of: Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Search Console Ahrefs Semrush The candidate must be able to use data to identify opportunities, diagnose problems, measure performance, and make strategic decisions. Key metrics may include: Organic revenue Organic traffic Non-branded search growth Rankings and search visibility Impressions Click-through rate Conversions Indexed pages Crawl health Backlink quality and authority Content performance AI Search / GEO visibility Brand mentions and citations within AI-generated results This role is expected to go beyond reporting numbers. The Strategy Lead should be able to explain: What happened? Why did it happen? What does the data tell us? What should we do next? Organization, Project Management & Execution Exceptional organization is a critical requirement for this position. The successful candidate must be able to: Manage numerous SEO, content, technical, GEO, and backlink initiatives simultaneously Maintain a clearly prioritized SEO roadmap and project calendar Break strategies into specific tasks, owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes Maintain detailed documentation of projects, tests, findings, decisions, and results Create repeatable processes and SOPs for the SEO team Track projects from initial concept through implementation and measurement Follow up proactively with developers, writers, designers, agencies, and other stakeholders Keep the team organized and accountable to deadlines Run highly organized weekly SEO meetings with clear priorities and action items Distinguish between urgent issues, high-impact opportunities, and lower-priority work Communicate project status, roadblocks, results, and next steps clearly to management Ensure recommendations are actually implemented rather than remaining in reports or audits We are looking for someone who creates structure rather than someone who needs structure created for them. Leadership & Team Management This position will lead a small SEO/content team and coordinate with other departments and external partners. Responsibilities include: Set strategic priorities and quarterly objectives Translate strategy into clear execution plans Assign and review work Create accountability across projects and team members Coach and develop team members Manage freelancers, agencies, or external SEO resources when needed Review quality of technical SEO, content, backlink, and GEO work Ensure projects move from recommendation to implementation Communicate SEO priorities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Hold team members and partners accountable for deadlines and results Required Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience Strong technical SEO expertise Strong understanding of on-page and off-page SEO Demonstrated experience developing SEO strategy, not simply executing tasks Exceptional organizational and project-management skills Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and team members simultaneously Strong knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4 Advanced working knowledge of Ahrefs and Semrush Experience with structured data and schema markup Experience developing and managing blog and content strategies Experience with backlink acquisition, guest posting, outreach, and authority building Experience conducting technical SEO audits Experience working with developers on SEO implementations Strong understanding of AI-powered search, GEO, and the changing search landscape Practical experience using AI tools within SEO workflows Experience leading or managing a small team Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Strong strategic thinking and prioritization skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills What We're Looking For We want someone who is a highly organized, proactive self-starter, strong strategist, and effective leader. You should naturally ask: What opportunities are we missing? Why are competitors outranking us? What has changed in Google or AI search? Where are the biggest technical SEO opportunities? What should we test next? What will have the greatest impact on organic revenue? Who owns the next action, when is it due, and how will we measure whether it worked? You should not need management to continually identify opportunities, establish your priorities, organize your workload, or follow up on unfinished projects. We are looking for someone who takes ownership. The right person will continuously study changes in Google Search, AI search, GEO, SEO technology, consumer search behavior, and industry best practices, translate those developments into actionable strategies, and ensure those strategies are executed successfully. Success in This Role Success means building a well-organized, measurable, and scalable organic-growth engine that improves visibility across both traditional search and the emerging AI-search ecosystem. We are looking for someone who can combine strategy, technical SEO, content, authority building, analytics, AI, leadership, organization, and disciplined execution to produce measurable business growth. title: SEO Writer
description: About AuctionTimepieces AuctionTimepieces (ATP) is a fee-free auction and marketplace platform for luxury watches. For decades, the watch market has run on middlemen, hidden margins, and opaque pricing. We're building the transparent alternative: a place where serious buyers and sellers of Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Richard Mille, Rolex, and beyond can transact directly and with confidence. We're early, which means you won't inherit someone else's mess. You'll build our organic search presence from the ground up, and you'll own it. The Role We're hiring one person to own everything organic: technical SEO, content strategy, and the copy that runs across the site. You'll d ---------- what we rank for, build the pages and systems that get us there, and write the words that turn search traffic into bidders and sellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who can run a crawl audit in the morning and write a sharp category page in the afternoon. What You'll Own Technical SEO Site architecture and crawlability for a marketplace where inventory changes constantly, including internal linking that pushes authority to the pages that matter. The auction lifecycle. D ---------- how live, ended, and sold listings are handled: what stays indexed, what redirects, and how sold results become permanent, rankable price-history assets. Faceted navigation (brand, model, reference, year, condition, price) built so it helps users without creating duplicate content or crawl traps. Structured data (Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, FAQ, and auction/event markup where applicable) and rich result eligibility. Performance: Core Web Vitals, mobile experience, and image optimization for high-resolution watch photography. Developer partnership: write clear tickets, QA releases, and catch SEO regressions before they ship. Keyword & Content Strategy A keyword map built around how collectors actually search: reference numbers (15500ST, 5711/1A), model names and nicknames, "price," "for sale," "auction results," and "vs." comparisons. Scaled page templates for brand hubs, model and reference pages, and sold-price archives, built with enough unique value that they rank rather than read as thin. An editorial calendar covering buying guides, authentication guides, reference deep-dives, market reports, and comparison content on fee-free selling versus traditional auction house and marketplace fees. Visibility in AI-driven search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar) alongside traditional rankings. Copywriting All core site copy: homepage, how it works, selling and consigning, brand and category pages, FAQs, and trust and authentication pages. On-page optimization across the site, including title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and image alt text. Listing standards. Set the SEO rules for listing titles and descriptions, and work with our listing-description workflow so every listing is search-friendly and on-brand. Brand voice. Write in a way that feels premium, knowledgeable, and credible to serious collectors. No generic e-commerce filler. Authority & Links Earn links and mentions from horology publications, watch blogs, collector communities, and press. Build the trust and expertise signals a platform handling high-value transactions needs to rank and convert. Monitor and maintain a clean backlink profile. Measurement & Reporting Own GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents). Report monthly to the founders on rankings, organic traffic, and indexation, and, most importantly, on organic sign-ups, bids, and seller leads. Track competitors including Chrono24, Bezel, Phillips, and eBay. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: A full technical and content audit of ---------- , a competitor gap analysis, and a prioritized roadmap. First 90 days: Technical foundations fixed and live, keyword map complete, core pages rewritten, scaled brand/model/reference page templates shipped, and a consistent publishing cadence running. 6 to 12 months: Clear growth in non-branded organic traffic, first-page rankings for priority brand, model, and reference terms, and organic search established as a real source of registered bidders and seller leads.

title: Operations Coordinator
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Simply Roofing is a US-based residential and commercial roofing company (Arizona & Texas). That said, this is not a script-reading call center job and it is not lead-scraping. You will email and speak with US business buyers directly, under your own name, as part of our company - you are just doing it with an experienced person behind you rather than alone. You will have to think on your feet, answer real questions about a real product, and be persistent without being annoying. We need someone US buyers understand easily and take seriously on the phone. WHO YOU WORK WITH You report to and work alongside our senior salesperson. He has spent his career in this industry. He takes the meetings, handles the pricing negotiations, and closes the deals. You are the person who makes sure he walks into every week with a full list of the right companies to talk to, that every quote he sent has been followed up on, and that nothing sits waiting on him without you flagging it. When he is on the road or on calls all day, you are the one keeping his pipeline moving. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run outbound outreach. Write and send introduction emails in professional US business English, and work a structured follow-up sequence. You write these yourself; we give you the framework and the product knowledge. - Get on the phone. Call prospects who have not replied, call the ones who have, qualify what they buy and how much, and hand the real opportunities to your salesperson with a proper introduction and a briefing on what you learned. Expect this to be a real part of your day, every day. - Qualify properly. Find out what grade and volume they use, who they buy from now, what they pay, when their contracts renew, and what would make them switch - and write all of it down. - Prepare quotes and chase them. Build price quotes from our pricing sheet for your salesperson to review, send them out, and follow up on every open quote on a schedule until we get a yes or a no. Most sales are lost to silence, not to a competitor - preventing that silence is one of the main reasons this job exists. - Coordinate samples. Get product samples out to prospects and follow up on the results - this is often the step that turns interest into an order. - Own the pipeline records. Keep the CRM current: every contact, every conversation, every next step, with dates. Send a short written end-of-day summary of what moved, what is stuck, and what needs your salesperson's attention tomorrow. He should never have to ask you where something stands. - See the first order through. When an account says yes, you stay with it: confirm the order details, pass them to our logistics team to get the truck scheduled, and keep the customer informed until it is delivered. You are not booking freight and you are not doing the invoicing - you are making sure the customer's first experience with us is a good one. REQUIREMENTS - Excellent spoken English with a neutral, easily understood accent. This is a hard requirement - you will be on the phone with US buyers, and it is the first thing we screen for. - Excellent written English. Your emails go to US business customers with no one editing them first. - At least 3 years in B2B sales, inside sales, appointment setting, sales support, or account management for US or other Western clients. Outbound experience specifically - not inbound support only. - Genuinely comfortable making cold calls to people who are not expecting you, and comfortable being told no repeatedly without losing momentum. - Organized to the point of being annoying about it. This job is mostly follow-up, and follow-up is where most salespeople lose deals. You are the safety net for someone else's pipeline as well as your own work. - Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a working headset. NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED) - Experience selling an industrial, chemical, or raw-material product, or selling into manufacturing plants. - Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar). - Any exposure to US freight or full-truckload shipping - useful for talking intelligently about delivery, though you will not be booking trucks. WHAT WE OFFER - $1,600 - $2,000 USD per month, paid twice monthly, direct - no agency taking a cut. - Performance bonus on closed business once you are past ramp - we will define it in writing with you at 90 days. - A raise review at 90 days and again at one year, based on results. - Paid Philippine holidays, and paid time off after 90 days. - Long-term, stable work, and a real industry education - you will learn this business from someone who has spent a career in it. As we grow, this seat grows with it. - Direct access to both the owner and the salesperson you support. No layers, no bureaucracy - if you bring us a real opportunity, we act on it that day. HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY We read every application that follows the instructions. Applications that do not follow them are deleted unread, because following written instructions precisely is most of this job. 1. Begin your reply with the word GRAPHITE in all capitals on the first line, by itself. 2. Record a voice clip of 60-90 seconds at ---------- and paste the link in your application. In the clip, in English: introduce yourself, then give us the actual opening you would use on a cold call to a US manufacturing company you have never spoken to before - the first 30 seconds, word for word, as you would really say it. You are calling to find out what they buy and to open the door for your salesperson, not to close anything. Do not read a prepared script; we can hear it, and we will pass. Applications without a voice clip will not be considered. 3. Answer these three questions in writing. Short and specific beats long and general. Question 1. Tell us about a prospect you personally followed up with more than four times before getting a result. What did you say differently each time, and how did it end? If it ended in a no, tell us that - a clean no is a useful answer. Question 2. You finally reach the buyer at a company that uses exactly what we sell. He says: "We've been buying from the same supplier for eleven years, we're happy, and I'm not looking to change." What do you say next - actually write the words - and what do you do with that account over the following six months to keep it warm for your salesperson? Question 3. Tell us about your experience with AI, what specific AI technologies you use and how you use them, and the most complex project you have used AI with.

title: Reverse Recruiter / U.S. Technical Job Search & Application Specialist
job_title: Reverse Recruiter / U.S. Technical Job Search & Application Specialist
description: Part-time, ongoing. Starting target: US$3.50–$5.00/hour, depending on demonstrated experience and quality. Initial hours: 8–10 hours/week; increases require approval and demonstrated value. ABOUT THE ROLE I am a U.S.-based telecommunications/RF/wireless engineer seeking an experienced reverse recruiter to manage a broad, high-quality professional job search. Your work will uncover strong direct-fit opportunities and credible career pivots, tailor truthful ATS-aligned resumes, submit approved applications after hire, and maintain an accurate application pipeline. Research judgment and factual integrity matter more than application volume. RESPONSIBILITIES • Search LinkedIn, Indeed, Google, employer career sites, and other reputable sources using Boolean/X-ray searches, synonyms, adjacent job families, competitor research, and company-site searches. • Find non-obvious opportunities beyond titles containing “RF” or “telecommunications.” Read full job descriptions and distinguish required qualifications, preferred qualifications, learnable gaps, and fatal gaps. • Search California first, credible U.S. remote roles next, and exceptional U.S. opportunities elsewhere. Prioritize approximately $150,000+ base salary or strong total compensation for the job seeker, while considering strategically valuable roles with compelling benefits, pension, growth, or pivot potential. • Verify that postings are open and actionable. Use official employer application links whenever available; flag alternative sources for verification. • Classify opportunities as Direct Fit, Adjacent Growth, Strategic Stretch, or Do Not Apply and explain the evidence behind each recommendation. • After hire, present opportunities for approval, tailor supported resumes and requested cover letters/application answers, perform quality checks, and submit only approved applications. • Work accurately with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, and similar systems. • Maintain a centralized Google Sheets/Excel tracker, prevent duplicates, preserve resume versions, and log submissions the same day. • Identify relevant recruiters or hiring managers for priority applications and prepare outreach drafts for approval. Track follow-ups and outcomes. SEARCH AREAS Telecommunications, public-safety communications, LMR, RF/wireless, spectrum/FCC, microwave, systems engineering, integration/validation, technical project/program management, solutions/customer engineering, field applications, utilities/energy, critical infrastructure, OT/industrial communications, satellite/space and defense communications, IoT/edge/sensing, wireless hardware and semiconductor systems, and credible network/data-center/cloud/AI infrastructure pivots. Discover additional job families through research. Do not imply unsupported specialist experience. REQUIRED SKILLS • Demonstrated U.S. professional job-search support, reverse recruiting, recruiting, sourcing, or career-services experience; engineering/technology experience is strongly preferred. • Strong technical job-description reading, transferable-skills analysis, Boolean/X-ray research, and employer-site sourcing. • Excellent written English and careful factual checking. • ATS resume tailoring without inventing experience, credentials, technologies, metrics, responsibilities, or job titles. • Application-system experience and disciplined Google Sheets/Excel tracking. • Ability to work independently, explain recommendations, follow written approval rules, and maintain confidentiality. Two or more years of relevant experience and examples of client interviews generated by your work are preferred. AI tools may support research and drafting, but all output must be verified and sensitive information must remain within approved tools. SELECTION PROCESS 1. Application review and shortlist. 2. Shortlisted applicants complete a small, unpaid 3-opportunity competency screen, explaining why each opportunity fits. This is an assessment only; no applications, employer outreach, or account access are involved. 3. Only the top 2 finalists receive a paid 20-opportunity research trial. Trial payment terms and any time cap will be agreed in writing before work begins. 4. One specialist is selected for ongoing part-time work based on research quality, technical judgment, factual integrity, communication, tracking, and cost/availability. The paid trial includes 8 Direct Fit, 6 Adjacent Growth, 3 Strategic Stretch, and 3 Do Not Apply opportunities with reasoned explanations. At least 6 of the 20 must be credible discoveries beyond simple “RF Engineer” or “Telecommunications Engineer” searches. No applications or employer outreach may be submitted during the trial. For each trial opportunity, record company, title, location/remote status, advertised compensation, official job URL, posting date/age and deadline when available, classification, fit score with explanation, 3–5 supported matching qualifications, learnable versus fatal gaps, career value, and recommended action. Clearly mark unavailable information. ACCURACY, ACCESS, AND PRIVACY The provided Master Career Record is the factual source of truth. Every major resume claim must be traceable to it or separately approved information. Ask about ambiguous experience. Do not add unsupported keywords or automatically advertise total years of experience. Employer-facing positioning and any salary expectations require approval. The operation uses one dedicated Gmail account owned by me. Trial candidates receive no Gmail or LinkedIn access. After hire, only controlled, explicitly approved access is granted. I retain ownership, recovery methods, and security controls. Do not change credentials, recovery details, forwarding, or permissions without authorization. LinkedIn work must follow the agreed access restrictions; any account access requires separate approval. Keep resumes, career records, application answers, correspondence, and trackers confidential. Use them only for this assignment. Do not share with third parties, subcontract, upload to unapproved AI/services, or retain unnecessary copies. Never mass-apply, duplicate applications, fabricate claims, or act on unverified closed/stale postings. Escalate uncertain application answers for review. PERFORMANCE AND CONTINUATION Provide concise weekly reports covering qualified opportunities, approvals, accurate submissions, recruiter responses, screening calls, interviews, follow-ups, hours, and proposed search improvements. Evaluate interview conversion after sufficient application volume, alongside research quality and process accuracy. Raw application count alone is not a success measure. Continuation depends on quality, reliability, truthful work, confidentiality, and compliance with approvals and budget. Repeated quality/process problems may lead to ending the engagement or replacement; fabrication, unauthorized applications, or security/privacy violations are grounds to end it. On departure, hand over current trackers, files, and outstanding actions; access will be revoked and personal copies of confidential material must be deleted. Approved work will be paid under the agreed terms. HOW TO APPLY Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your response with SIGNAL FOUND and answer: 1. What experience do you have applying to U.S. professional jobs for another person, particularly technical/engineering roles? 2. How do you assess actual qualifications and separate transferable skills, learnable gaps, and fatal gaps? 3. Explain your Boolean/X-ray process and give an example of a non-obvious technical career pivot you identified. 4. Which ATS/application systems have you personally used? 5. How do you tailor resumes for ATS alignment without inventing experience? 6. How do you track applications, resume versions, contacts, follow-ups, and outcomes and prevent duplicates? 7. Describe client interview results from your work, without disclosing confidential client information. 8. What is your hourly rate, weekly availability, and usual working hours/time zone? 9. Approximately how much time does a well-researched, tailored application take you, including quality checks? 10. Confirm that you understand the unpaid 3-opportunity screen, paid 20-opportunity trial for only the top 2 finalists, and prohibition on applications and Gmail/LinkedIn access during the trial.

title: Customer Service Manager (E-commerce / Dropshipping)
description: Job description We are an e-commerce group running several Shopify dropshipping stores, selling fashion and home decor worldwide. We ship thousands of orders a month and we are growing. Four representatives on Manila hours. You hire and you let go, together with the owner. Response time. How fast customers hear back from us, across every store, is yours. You hold it when volume spikes. Customer refunds. When we pay a customer back, we lose the sale and we keep the cost of the product, the shipping and the ad that won the order. You will know exactly why customers ask for their money back, per store and per product, and you will bring that number down. Disputes. Chargebacks and payment disputes are part of this business. You do not have to file every case yourself, but you own the result: no deadline is missed, and the cases we can win, we win. Root causes. In dropshipping, most complaints start upstream, with a supplier or a product listing, not with your team. Your job is to find the pattern, prove it with order numbers, and take it to the product and supply chain teams until it is fixed. We would rather solve the cause than pay the refund. A team that runs without you. You will train a deputy and write down how decisions get made, so a representative can act alone instead of waiting for you. A queue that only moves when you are online is not a working team. What we are looking for You have managed a customer service team before. You have set targets, run reviews, and turned an underperformer around or moved them on. You have worked in dropshipping. You know how to run support when fulfilment sits with a supplier overseas and transit times are long. This is the one thing we will not compromise on. You know your way around chargebacks and payment disputes well enough to audit your team's work and coach them. You understand consumer protection rules in Western markets, or you learn them fast. We will teach you what we know. You work in spreadsheets by instinct. You can match two lists, find the pattern, and put it in front of us in a form we can act on. Your written English is good enough that a European customer reads it as professional. You speak up. If a process is broken, we hear it from you first. You are reachable and predictable, and you arrange cover before you need it. What we offer $6 per hour. Working towards flat fee + bonus. Direct access to the owner, no layers in between Real authority over your team and your process Paid training while you learn our stores, tools and systems Software we built ourselves that shows every ticket, refund and dispute across all stores in one place, so you manage on facts Our tools Shopify, Gorgias, Chargeflow, Hubstaff, Google Sheets, Slack. title: Shopify & TikTok Shop Manager
description: READ THIS ENTIRE AD BEFORE YOU APPLY. If you skip this and send a generic application, you will be ignored. Job title: Shopify & TikTok Shop Manager We need someone who can fully manage and grow our Shopify store and TikTok Shop. This starts as a part-time role. It becomes bigger, and the pay goes up, as quickly as you grow sales and profit. Pay $70 per week to start. Pay increases as quickly as you increase sales and profit. You can work as many hours or as few hours as you need in order to grow the stores as quickly as possible. As it sits now there isn't a lot to do, so most of the hours you spend will be put towards building the stores. This is not a “wait to be told what to do” job. You will own both stores day to day and find ways to increase sales, margins and profits. WHAT YOU WILL DO Shopify -Run the store: products, collections, pages, apps, discounts, bundles, merchandising -Find and create new products, write listings, set pricing, keep inventory accurate -Manage orders, fulfillment issues, returns, and refunds -Answer customers (email/chat/tickets) -Improve the store so more visitors buy -Promote the store on our social media channels -Link the store to all sales channels (currently not linked to Meta and likely others) TikTok Shop -Run Seller Center: listings, pricing, promos, shop health, compliance -Get any of our current products in the store that aren't already there -Find and launch products that can sell on TikTok -Build and manage creator/affiliate campaigns: find creators, outreach, briefs, samples, commissions, track who posted and what sold -Create and manage ads (GMV Max, Spark Ads, Product Ads). Test, kill losers, scale winners -Handle customer messages, orders, and returns -Promote TikTok Shop through our social channels and turn winning content into ads Both stores -Drive results, not busywork -Work independently -Make suggestions and implement them -Keep Shopify and TikTok Shop aligned, as well as all of our social media -Send a simple weekly recap: sales increase, what's selling, what you did, what you want to do WHO SHOULD APPLY You already know Shopify and TikTok Shop. You can show stores you have helped grow. You can: -manage both platforms without hand-holding -run creator/affiliate outreach -run small ad campaigns -handle customers and orders -research products and launch them -promote products on social media MUST HAVE -Real experience with BOTH Shopify and TikTok Shop -Proof: store links and screenshots (sales/GMV, orders, ads, creator/affiliate results) plus what you personally did -Strong written English -Willing to start part-time at $70/week and grow pay with results DO NOT APPLY IF You have only done product uploads or customer service You have only posted on TikTok and never managed TikTok Shop You cannot show proof You need daily supervision You send “I’m interested” with no details HOW TO APPLY Use this exact subject line: I can fully manage and grow both Shopify and TikTok shop Include: 3–5 sentences on Shopify and TikTok Shop stores you managed or grew Links or screenshots as proof What you personally owned How many hours per week you can work How soon you can start No exact subject line and no proof = no reply.

title: Customer Service Representative (Long-Term, Full-Time) - Pest Control Company in Colorado, USA
job_title: Customer Service Representative (Long-Term, Full-Time) - Pest Control Company in Colorado, USA
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Guardian Pest Management is a locally owned and operated pest control company that has been serving residential and commercial customers throughout the South Metro Denver area of Colorado since 2000. We are known for reliable service, honest communication, and long-term customer relationships. You can learn more about us at ---------- . We are a small, family-oriented team. That means the person in this seat is not a number in a call center. You will be one of the first voices our customers hear, and you will be trusted with real responsibility from the beginning. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a friendly, motivated, detail-oriented Customer Service Representative with excellent spoken and written English to join our team on a long-term basis. This is important, so we want to be direct about it: we are not hiring for a short-term project or a trial gig. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with one company for years, learn our business deeply, and eventually take on more responsibility and leadership. If you are looking for a few months of work or you are juggling several clients at once, this role is not the right fit. If you want a stable home with one employer who invests in you, please keep reading. WHAT YOU WILL DO Answer inbound phone calls promptly and professionally during our business hours. Explain our pest control services to prospective and current customers, and sell services over the phone. Schedule appointments in our software and coordinate scheduling and routing details with our technicians. Gather and record customer information accurately, and keep detailed, accurate notes in every customer account. Take and process customer payments when needed. Handle basic account questions and resolve customer concerns in a professional, solution-focused way. Respond to voicemails, emails, texts, and online inquiries in a timely manner. Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances. Assist with payroll processing and general office administrative tasks as needed. Help make sure every new service is set up correctly from the very start. REQUIREMENTS Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. You will be on the phone with American customers every day, so this is the single most important requirement. Strong written English for email, text, and account notes. One to three years of customer service experience preferred, ideally phone-based and with US-based customers. Comfortable selling services over the phone. You do not need to be a hard closer, but you do need to be confident asking for the sale. Strong computer skills and comfort learning new software. Experience with Excel, Word, Google Workspace, and any scheduling or CRM platform is a plus. Pest control industry experience is a plus and will move your application to the top of the list, but it is not required. We will train the right person. Highly organized with strong attention to detail, and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Honesty, integrity, and a strong work ethic. We check references and we mean it. Availability to work full-time during US Mountain Time business hours, Monday through Friday. A reliable computer, a quality noise-cancelling headset, and a stable, fast internet connection with a quiet place to take calls. A backup internet source (mobile data or a nearby alternative) is strongly preferred. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS Competitive monthly salary based on your experience. Please include your expected monthly rate in your application. 13th month pay. Annual pay increases based on performance and tenure. We expect the person in this seat to be earning meaningfully more in year three than in year one. Performance bonuses and commission opportunities on phone sales. Paid time off and paid holidays. Paid training and ongoing coaching. You will be trained on our services, our software, and our phone process, and you will get regular feedback so you can keep improving. Long-term stability and a clear path to more responsibility as we grow. HOW TO APPLY Please follow these instructions carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed. Step 1. Reply with a short message telling us why you are interested in a long-term role with our company, your years of customer service experience, whether you have any pest control or home services experience, and your expected monthly rate. Step 2. Record a short video or audio recording, no more than three minutes total, answering these three questions in your own words. Please do not read from a script. Question 1. Please introduce yourself and tell us about your customer service experience, especially any experience on the phone with US-based customers. Question 2. Tell us about a time an upset customer called you. What was the situation, what did you say, and how did it end? Question 3. Why are you looking for a long-term position with one company, and where do you want to be in three years? Step 3. Upload your recording to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted), or Loom, and include the link in your application. Make sure the link is set so we can open it without requesting access. We review every application that follows these steps, and we respond to the applicants we would like to interview. Thank you for taking the time to apply. We are looking forward to meeting you.

title: Meta Ads Specialist

We are hiring an experienced Facebook Ads Manager who can confidently manage Meta advertising for multiple client accounts from end to end. This is not an entry-level role, and it is not a social media posting position. We need someone who has personally built, launched, tested, analyzed, and optimized paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns that generate real leads for service businesses. For applicants in the Philippines, this is an overnight schedule: - Approximately 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing daylight-saving time - Approximately 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing standard time The U.S. Eastern schedule is fixed, so your local hours will shift when U.S. daylight-saving time changes. every open item gets closed Strong written English for clear vendor, team, and cross-functional coordination Reliable availability during Pacific Time hours, plus ownership of after-hours coverage when urgent issues arise Calm and decisive under pressure — especially when a same-day turn or emergency repair is on the line Nice to Have Experience coordinating operations across 100+ units or multiple submarkets Familiarity with damage-claims processes (AirCover, host guarantees, insurance) and a track record of recovering costs Working knowledge of basic home systems (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliances) — enough to triage and brief vendors accurately Familiarity with San Diego / Southern California vendor markets

title: Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper for Event Management Company
job_title: Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper for Event Management Company
description: Do You Notice When the Numbers Don’t Make Sense? Are you the person who spots the missing transaction, questions an unusual charge, and keeps working until every number has an explanation? H+A is looking for a full-time, virtual Accounting Clerk who takes pride in accuracy, organization, and follow-through. You will support H+A's financial operations and multiple association clients. Your work will include account reconciliations, expense management, accounts payable and receivable, client invoicing, and financial reporting. This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys detailed work, manages recurring deadlines without constant reminders, communicates problems early, and understands that accurate financial records protect both our clients and our reputation. We value people who take ownership, think ahead, solve problems, support their teammates, and continually look for ways to improve their work. How to Apply - Attention to detail is essential in this position, so please follow these instructions carefully. Send an email with the subject line: Every Number Has a Story | Accounting Clerk Application Please include: Your current resume. A video with the following: A brief introduction explaining why your experience prepares you for this position. The H+A core value that resonates most with you and a brief explanation of why. Your location, time zone, and the hours you can consistently work in the U.S. Central Time Zone. Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered. We are looking for more than someone who can enter transactions. We want a dependable accounting professional who asks thoughtful questions, protects confidential information, and helps us trust the story our numbers are telling. The Accounting Clerk supports our company's and clients' financial operations. They will maintain accurate financial records, reconcile bank, credit card, and payment-processing accounts, prepare client invoices, track reimbursable expenses, and produce timely financial reports. This position requires exceptional accuracy, strong follow-through, confidentiality, and the ability to manage financial information for multiple organizations. Responsibilities: BANK AND ACCOUNT RECONCILIATION Reconcile company and client checking, savings, and investment accounts each month. Reconcile company and client credit card statements. Reconcile merchant-processing accounts, including registration payments, credit card deposits, processing fees, refunds, chargebacks, and bank deposits. Research and resolve discrepancies, duplicate transactions, missing deposits, and uncategorized expenses. Confirm that account balances agree with bank statements and supporting documentation. Maintain separate and accurate records for each H+A client. Prepare monthly reconciliation reports for the Owner/CEO's review. Escalate unusual transactions, unreconciled balances, or suspected errors promptly. EXPENSE MANAGEMENT Manage financial activity within Expensify. Review submitted expenses for receipts, appropriate coding, business purpose, client assignment, and approval. Import approved expenses into the accounting system. Identify missing receipts, incomplete descriptions, duplicate expenses, and incorrect client allocations. Track reimbursable expenses paid by H+A on behalf of clients. Maintain documentation that supports every reimbursement request. Assist employees and team members with expense-report questions. CLIENT INVOICING AND ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE Prepare accurate and timely client invoices for management fees, project fees, event-related charges, and reimbursable expenses. Attach supporting documentation when required. Confirm that expenses appear on the correct client invoice. Track outstanding invoices and accounts receivable. Prepare aging reports and identify overdue balances. Send approved payment reminders or provide follow-up information to the Owner/CEO. Apply client payments accurately within the accounting system. Research short payments, overpayments, duplicate payments, and unapplied credits. Maintain records of deposits, credits, refunds, and adjustments. ACCOUNTS PAYABLE Review vendor invoices for accuracy, proper authorization, and correct company or client coding. Enter approved bills into the accounting system. Match invoices with contracts, purchase approvals, receipts, or other supporting documents. Prepare payment schedules for review and approval. Track vendor due dates and help prevent late fees. Maintain current vendor records and payment documentation. Assist with gathering W-9 forms and year-end 1099 information. Identify duplicate invoices, unexpected charges, or changes in vendor pricing. FINANCIAL REPORTING Prepare monthly financial reports for H+A and assigned clients. Generate profit and loss statements, balance sheets, accounts receivable reports, budget-to-actual reports, and other requested reports. Prepare clear summaries that identify discrepancies, outstanding items, and areas requiring management attention. Assist with event-specific financial reports, including registration revenue, sponsorship revenue, exhibitor income, vendor expenses, refunds, and final event results. Maintain spreadsheets or tracking reports used for client reporting. Provide accurate supporting schedules to the Owner/CEO, client leaders, CPA, or tax professionals. MONTH-END AND YEAR-END SUPPORT Follow a documented month-end closing checklist for each organization. Confirm that all bank, credit card, merchant, and expense accounts have been reconciled. Review uncategorized transactions and outstanding reconciliation items. Verify that client reimbursements and management fees have been invoiced. Organize reports and supporting documentation for monthly client review. Assist the CPA with year-end close, tax preparation, audits, and requested documentation. Help prepare records for 1099 reporting and other annual financial requirements. Maintain organized electronic files according to the company’s document-retention standards. INTERNAL CONTROLS AND CONFIDENTIALITY Protect confidential company, client, employee, vendor, and banking information. Follow established approval procedures for bills, reimbursements, refunds, credits, and account changes. Never release payments, change vendor banking information, or process unusual refunds without proper approval. Maintain a clear audit trail for financial entries, corrections, and adjustments. Immediately report suspected fraud, phishing attempts, irregular transactions, or security concerns. Follow company password, multifactor authentication, and data-security requirements. GENERAL SUPPORT Respond promptly and professionally to internal and client accounting questions. Communicate missing information and upcoming deadlines clearly. Document recurring accounting procedures. Recommend ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting. Participate in regular meetings with the Owner/CEO. Complete other accounting and administrative duties as assigned. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS At least three years of bookkeeping, accounting-clerk, or accounting-assistant experience. Experience supporting a U.S.-based company or clients. Practical knowledge of bank, credit card, and merchant-account reconciliation. Experience preparing invoices and tracking accounts receivable. Experience reviewing vendor invoices and maintaining accounts-payable records. Proficiency with QuickBooks Desktop and Quickbooks Online. Prefer experience moving files from Quickbooks Desktop to Quickbooks Online platform. Experience with Expensify or a similar expense-management system. Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills, including filters, sorting, formulas, and reconciliation worksheets. Ability to understand a profit and loss statement, balance sheet, general ledger, and accounts-receivable aging report. Strong written and spoken English. Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Ability to manage multiple organizations, accounts, and deadlines without mixing financial information. Strong judgment and willingness to ask questions when information appears incomplete or incorrect. Proven ability to handle confidential financial information. Reliable computer, secure internet connection, and a professional remote workspace. Ability to maintain regular working-hour overlap with the H+A team in the Central Time Zone. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field. QuickBooks Online certification. Experience working with association-management, event-management, or professional-services companies. Experience handling books for multiple clients or business entities. Experience reconciling Stripe, PayPal, ---------- , event-registration platforms, or other merchant processors. Experience with deferred revenue, event deposits, registration refunds, sponsorships, and reimbursable client expenses. Familiarity with U.S. GAAP and accrual-based accounting. Experience supporting a CPA or assisting with month-end and year-end close. Experience with Gusto or another U.S. payroll platform. Experience gathering W-9 information and supporting 1099 preparation. H+A seeks someone who: Notices when numbers do not make sense. Enjoys detailed, repetitive work and completes it consistently. Meets deadlines without repeated reminders. Documents their work so another person can follow it. Communicates problems early. Takes ownership of researching discrepancies. Respects approval boundaries. Can shift between several clients while maintaining accuracy. Remains calm when deadlines overlap. Understands that accuracy and confidentiality directly affect H+A’s reputation. H+A's Core Value Competencies: Fanatical attention to details and deadlines, and takes ownership of tasks and projects Continually exceeding expectations and hungry for achievement Innovative and resourceful problem-solving by staying curious, relentless, and unstoppable Team player: fun, humble, and authentic Anticipate needs, understand long-term objectives, and act with the clients’ success in mind Exhibits professionalism in all things Honors the value of reputation of individual and company

description: About Us We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a long-term editor who understands that difference and can move fluidly between content types. The Role We need a versatile video editor who is genuinely strong across styles — long-form YouTube, short-form clips, paid ad creatives, and VSLs (Video Sales Letters) — plus can design scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails. You'll take raw footage (talking-head, screen recordings, interviews, UGC-style clips) and turn it into whatever format the project calls for, always built around retention and conversion, not vanity metrics. This is a combined editing + graphic design role — we're not looking to hire separate specialists for each format. Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis. What You'll Be Doing Editing long-form YouTube videos (typically 10-25 minutes) for pacing, clarity, and retention Cutting short-form content (Shorts/Reels/TikTok-style clips), often repurposed from long-form footage Editing VSLs — structuring hooks, pain points, proof, and calls-to-action to move a viewer toward a buying decision Editing paid ad creatives (Meta/YouTube/TikTok ads) built to convert, not just entertain Designing custom YouTube thumbnails for every long-form video (high-CTR, on-brand) Adding b-roll, captions/subtitles, sound design, music, and motion graphics where it serves the content — not for flash Following brand guidelines and keeping a consistent visual style across formats and channels Organizing and managing project files/assets so nothing gets lost between revisions Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth What We're Looking For Proven range across long-form YouTube AND short-form content — please only apply if you're genuinely strong at both, not one with the other as an afterthought Real experience editing VSLs and/or direct-response ad creatives — you understand hooks, pacing toward a CTA, and structuring for persuasion, not just aesthetics Graphic design skills for thumbnails (Photoshop, Canva, or similar) — this is not optional Strong sense of pacing and storytelling for content meant to build trust and drive action, across every format Comfortable with captions, basic color correction, audio cleanup, and motion graphics/text animation Understanding of what makes B2C/coaching/course-style content convert (clarity, credibility, calls-to-action) vs. what makes it "viral" — we care about the former Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions Strong English communication skills Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established Nice to Have Experience editing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically Experience with AI tools for editing efficiency (transcription, rough cuts, etc.) Basic understanding of YouTube SEO (titles, descriptions, tags) Direct response / performance marketing background (you know what a good ad "feels" like, not just what looks good) To Apply Please send: A portfolio/demo reel that shows range — long-form YouTube, short-form, at least one VSL or ad example, and thumbnail examples. We want to see all of it, not just your best format Your typical turnaround time per video/project Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per video, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer — Remote, Long-Term Contract Role
job_title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer — Remote, Long-Term Contract Role
description: Our media agency helps business owners and leaders grow their online presence. We strategize, create, and manage videos, graphics, and social media content for our clients. Because every client is different, each piece of content should match their unique voice, style, and brand. We are looking for a creative, dependable, and efficient Video Editor & Graphic Designer to join our growing team. This is a remote, long-term contract opportunity paid on a per-project basis. We want someone who is highly skilled and has experience editing long-form and short-term video. Each week we will need long-form and short-form videos edited, and graphics created for our clients. This role is ideal for someone who produces excellent work, follows instructions carefully, responds quickly, meets deadlines consistently, and communicates proactively. We are looking for someone who is truly on top of their assignments and can deliver polished first drafts with strong attention to detail. Our goal is not to repeatedly request revisions for avoidable mistakes, missed instructions, or quality issues. We care about creativity, but excellence, reliability, ownership, and communication are equally important. Responsibilities - You will help create content for multiple client brands, including: - Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts - Long-form YouTube videos and podcast episodes - B-roll and storytelling-style videos - Talking-head videos - Trend-based and educational content - Social media carousels and static graphics - YouTube thumbnails - Branded graphics and other supporting social assets - Revisions based on internal or client feedback You will also be expected to: - Review all instructions, references, and brand guidelines before editing - Keep each client’s editing style distinct and consistent - Add accurate captions, music, transitions, graphics, and relevant B-roll - Organize and upload completed files correctly - Keep project statuses updated in Notion - Communicate immediately if footage, instructions, or other resources are missing - Notify the team before a deadline if an assignment may be delayed - Complete revisions promptly and apply previous feedback to future work The ideal candidate: - Has strong short-form and long-form video-editing experience - Has great graphic-design experience - Understands pacing, storytelling, hooks, retention, and current social media editing styles - Pays close attention to spelling, captions, formatting, and client instructions - Is highly organized and able to manage multiple deadlines - Communicates clearly and proactively - Responds quickly and acknowledges new assignments or feedback promptly - Takes ownership without needing repeated reminders - Consistently delivers excellent, polished first drafts that minimize unnecessary revision requests - Checks their own work carefully before submitting it - Is receptive to feedback, completes revisions efficiently, and applies that feedback to future work - Stays ahead of deadlines and keeps the team informed without needing to be chased - Has reliable internet, sufficient storage, and the equipment needed to edit consistently - Is interested in a stable, long-term position with room to grow Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Canva, Photoshop, or similar editing and design software is preferred. Experience working with personal brands, founders, podcasts, or social media agencies is a plus. Turnaround Expectations Unless otherwise agreed upon: - Short-form first drafts should generally be completed within 48 hours - Long-form first drafts should generally be completed within 3–5 business days - Standard revisions should be completed within one business day - Any potential delay must be communicated before the deadline, along with a revised delivery time - Applicants should have the capacity to complete multiple short-form videos each week while also supporting long-form and graphic-design assignments. Compensation This is a contract role paid per completed deliverable. Starting rates: - $15 per short-form video - $40 per long-form video - Graphic-design rates will be agreed upon based on the type and complexity of the asset There is an opportunity for consistent assignments and increased rates as the agency and the role grow. Paid Trial Final candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial project. The trial will evaluate: - Editing quality - Ability to follow instructions - Turnaround time - Communication - Attention to detail - Responsiveness to revisions - The paid trial does not guarantee an ongoing contract. How to Apply Please include the following in your application: - A brief introduction and overview of your editing experience - A link to your portfolio (A portfolio is required for consideration. If your application does not include a working portfolio link with relevant examples, we will not be reaching out or moving your application forward. Please make sure we can view your work without requesting access.) - Examples of thumbnails, or other graphic-design work - Your typical turnaround time for short-form and long-form videos - How many short-form and long-form videos you can realistically complete each week - Your current availability and expected working hours - If you're available to attend our weekly Monday morning meeting at 10:00am Please begin your application with the words “I'm your next level video editor” so we know you read the entire description. We are looking to hire immediately and are excited to find someone who wants to grow with our team.

title: Claims Support Officer
description: Claims Support Officer Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hour **To Apply** ---------- The Claims Support Officer will provide administrative support to the Claims Consultant and help progress insurance claims accurately and promptly. Working under the Claims Consultant’s direction, the role will assist with claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, record maintenance, and general claims administration for an Australian insurance broking firm. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Claims Lodgements - Assist the Claims Consultant with lodging new insurance claims - Gather and collate the required information, then lodge claims accurately and promptly in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions - Record claim details and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM Insurer and Claims Follow-Up - Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims - Make follow-up calls and remain on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps - Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue - Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes - Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant Documentation and Information Requests - Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant - Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, and repair or replacement information - Follow up outstanding documentation and report progress to the Claims Consultant - File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system Claims Administration - Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records - Diary and action follow-ups to help keep claims progressing - Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultantz - Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly - Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant REPORTING STRUCTURE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES The Claims Support Officer reports directly to the Claims Consultant and performs all duties under their direction. This is primarily an administrative and support-based role. - The role does not independently manage client relationships, provide claims advice, or make decisions on behalf of the broker or Claims Consultant - All client-facing matters and substantive claims discussions remain the responsibility of the Claims Consultant - Client or third-party follow-ups must be limited to the specific tasks and instructions provided by the Claims Consultant SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE You Must Have - Previous experience in administration, claims support, insurance support, or a similarly process-driven role - Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling claim information and documentation - Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to monitor multiple follow-ups and deadlines - Clear and professional communication skills, including confidence contacting insurers and other parties for factual updates and outstanding information - Ability to follow detailed instructions, work within defined authority, and escalate issues appropriately - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM and claims-management systems - Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work full-time during Australian business hours, Monday to Friday Nice to Have - Experience working for an insurance brokerage or general insurer - Previous exposure to insurance claims lodgement and claims administration - Experience communicating with insurers, claims teams, loss assessors, or repairers and using insurance, claims, or CRM systems - Basic understanding of the general insurance claims lifecycle and its common documentation **To Apply** ----------

title: Creative Marketer Wanted – Join a Mission That Matters
job_title: Creative Marketer Wanted – Join a Mission That Matters
description: MARKETING VIRTUAL ASSISTANT | REMOTE | PHILIPPINES | FULL-TIME ABOUT ONE WAY UK One Way UK is a Christian business and ministry dedicated to equipping churches, children's workers, ministries and Christian communicators with creative tools that help them share the message of the Gospel. We design and manufacture puppets, provide training, create ministry resources and run events that equip people to communicate creatively and effectively. At the heart of everything we do is a desire to see people equipped, encouraged and inspired to make a difference. As we move into an exciting new season, we're looking for a Marketing Virtual Assistant to join our team and help us tell our story, grow our community and reach more people. -THE ROLE- We're looking for someone who's: CREATIVE, DRIVEN AND ORGANISED And most importantly, somebody who wants to make a difference! You'll help take responsibility for the day-to-day marketing of One Way UK. THIS ISN'T SIMPLY A SOCIAL MEDIA POSTING ROLE! You'll work closely with the Managing Director to plan and deliver marketing campaigns across our products, resources, training and events. You'll help take ideas, priorities and content and turn them into consistent, engaging and measurable marketing activity. A big part of the role will be establishing a strong rhythm of marketing throughout the year, nurturing our existing audience, reaching new people and building a stronger community around One Way UK. -KEY RESPONSIBILITIES- -EMAIL MARKETING- * Create, schedule and send marketing emails and newsletters. * Build campaigns around products, events, training and resources. * Segment audiences and repurpose existing content into engaging emails. * Develop, build and manage automated email nurture campaigns and customer journeys. * Monitor results including opens, clicks, responses and conversions. -MARKETING CAMPAIGNS- * Work alongside the Managing Director to plan and develop marketing campaigns. * Turn campaign ideas into coordinated activity across email, social media, graphics, video and other channels. * Coordinate campaigns around product launches, events, training and ministry resources. * Help maintain a consistent rhythm of marketing throughout the year. * Monitor performance and identify opportunities to improve results. -SOCIAL MEDIA & COMMUNITY- * Manage and schedule content across One Way UK's social media channels. * Turn ideas, photographs, videos, products and existing material into engaging content. * Help build a genuine community rather than simply broadcasting adverts. * Engage appropriately with comments and conversations. * Identify opportunities for useful, engaging and shareable content. -GRAPHIC DESIGN- Create professional, on-brand graphics for social media, events, products, email campaigns, promotions and ministry resources. We currently use Canva and have our branding and existing designs set up there. However, if you have another preferred design tool or workflow, we're open to considering it. -VIDEO & REELS- We're not looking for a professional video editor, but you should be comfortable taking existing footage and turning it into simple, engaging content, including: * Basic editing and uploading of videos such as podcasts and tutorials. * Cutting longer videos into shorter clips and Reels. * Adding captions, titles and simple graphics. * Repurposing video content across different platforms. -OUTREACH- Outreach will occasionally form part of the role around particular campaigns and opportunities. This may include researching relevant churches or potential customers, creating targeted contact lists and supporting email outreach campaigns. This isn't primarily a lead-generation role, but outreach is one of the tools we'll use alongside our wider marketing activity. -PAID ADVERTISING- Paid advertising isn't currently a major part of our marketing activity, but it's an area we want to develop. As our marketing grows, you'll have the opportunity to help us create, manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns to reach new audiences and generate measurable sales. Previous experience with platforms such as Meta Ads or Google Ads would be an advantage, but isn't essential. -YOUR FIRST CAMPAIGN- Your first major project will be helping us market the EQUIP FESTIVAL, our Christian creative ministry event. You'll work alongside the Managing Director on email marketing, social media, graphics, video content, targeted outreach and other activity designed to drive registrations in the final weeks before the event. Beyond Equip, you'll help us establish a consistent rhythm of marketing around our products, training, resources and events throughout the year. The aim isn't simply to keep our marketing channels busy. description: TALENTA Commerce TALENTA Commerce is a managed ecommerce agency. We need an ecommerce email specialist for client work in Klaviyo and Omnisend. You will audit accounts, rebuild flows, write copy, launch campaigns, and report results. Generic AI copy will not pass review. Build and QA emails across desktop, mobile, dark mode, and image-off. Clean links and UTMs required. Create 90-day campaign calendars tied to launches, seasonality, and inventory Set up reporting that matters: flow revenue, campaign revenue per recipient, click-to-purchase, unsub and spam rates, quality of list growth Find and fix deliverability issues: authentication, warmup, bounce and complaint hygiene, engagement-based sending Work across multiple client accounts. Bring recommendations before anyone asks. Requirements Real ecommerce email experience. DTC, Shopify, or BigCommerce preferred. Advanced production work in Klaviyo and Omnisend. Deep skill in one plus real work in the other is acceptable. Recipe editing is not. You can build flows from scratch and explain the logic. Strong written English and conversion copy. Portfolio of campaigns and automations you personally built. Results you can defend: revenue, RPR, recovery rate, or repeat purchase lift. Open rate alone is not a result. Practical knowledge of list hygiene, suppressions, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Apple Mail Privacy Protection, and ecommerce rules under CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR. You know how to stop duplicate sends when flows overlap or when a brand is moving platforms. You can work independently, document what you did, and talk clearly with an agency owner and clients. Helpful, not required Shopify Plus, Recharge or other subscription tools, BigCommerce SMS inside Klaviyo or Omnisend Enough HTML/CSS to fix broken email layouts Agency experience across more than one brand How to apply Subject line: TALENTA Commerce eMail Specialist — [YOUR NAME] Start the application with this exact sentence: I build ecommerce email systems. Then include all of the following: A short summary of your ecommerce email work: platforms, store types, and what you personally owned. Two examples of emails or flows you built. Screenshots, Loom, or anonymized exports are fine. Label each one Klaviyo or Omnisend. One measurable result you owned. Include the baseline, the change, and what you did. Short written answers to 2 of the following questions: (Pick any two) How do you stop a customer from getting an abandoned checkout email and a campaign for the same product on the same day? A client’s open rates fall 25% in two weeks. What do you check first, and in what order? What is the difference between an engaged segment and a purchased-in-last-90-days segment, and when do you use each? When do you use a metric-triggered flow, a date-property flow, and a segment-triggered flow? How do you keep email, SMS, and push from colliding inside one automation? How do you write a welcome series that is not “here is 10% off” in email one? Your availability and how you prefer to bill: hourly, project, or retainer. A 2 to 4 minute video introducing yourself and walking through one automation you built. Hide confidential data. If the opening sentence, examples, result, or written answers are missing, the application will not be reviewed. Do not apply if your main experience is VA work, inbox admin, data entry, social posting, or generating emails with ChatGPT. Work usually starts with a paid audit on one account. Strong work turns into ongoing Klaviyo and Omnisend client work.
